title: MARS
paper_title: Large-Scale Multi-Sequence Pretraining for Generalizable MRI Analysis in Versatile Clinical Applications
core_mech: MARS 用 3D Swin 加结构/序列双支路、元数据与对比约束，并通过重建/合成把 anatomy-invariant 与 sequence-specific 信息解耦。
core_mech_en: Multi-sequence 3D MRI foundation model pairing a 3D Swin backbone with dual structure/sequence branches and acquisition metadata to disentangle anatomy from contrast.
input_desc: 跨 10 个解剖区、多 MRI 序列的 3D volume 及其遮挡/跨序列变体
input_en: Multi-sequence 3D MRI volumes across 10 anatomical regions with sequence metadata and cross-sequence masking
output_desc: 可迁移 3D Swin 表示，以及供分割、分类、配准、预测和报告任务使用的权重
output_en: Disentangled anatomical and sequence representations transferable across 44 segmentation, classification, registration, and report tasks
gaps: The original MARS implementation is linked and pinned; its defining pretraining and downstream workflow have not been integrated and tested here.
